description: Railway lines of Cambodia is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Cambodia. This data is the vector polyline data of rainway in Cambodia for many status such as existing, under construction, planned / potential railway lines in Cambodia. Coverage: Cambodia. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Cambodia. Its tags are Rail, Transport infrastructure and facilities. It offers 6 resource(s) in geojson, jpeg, kml, shp, wms. The portal shows 2020-03-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is unspecified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
